info.title: Twitter API - Tweet Replies V2
info.description: Get tweet replies with advanced sorting options.

source.description: The source client of the tweet

createdAt.description: The date and time the tweet was created

isLimitedReply.description: Whether the tweet is a limited reply

CostEstimate.description: Read-only cost quote for the exact request. No Provider call, billing reservation, durable job, or price lock is created.

currency.description: Quote currency. Always USD in this version.

estimate_kind.description: `exact` is a fully determined customer price; `upper_bound` has a locally enforceable ceiling in `max_cost_micros_usd`; `estimate` depends on terminal usage and may exceed the quoted amount.

estimated_cost_micros_usd.description: Quoted customer cost in micro-USD (1 USD = 1,000,000 micros).

max_cost_micros_usd.description: Optional hard customer-cost ceiling in micro-USD. Present for `exact` and `upper_bound`; omitted for `estimate`.

pricing_version.description: Optional immutable or compiled pricing version.

estimated_at.description: UTC timestamp when the quote was produced.

metadata.description: Bounded non-sensitive quote metadata, such as a canonical model or profile key.

XAISACostMode.name: X-AISA-Cost-Mode
XAISACostMode.description: Set to `quote` to estimate this exact request without executing data, creating a job, or authorizing spend. A successful quote is HTTP 200 with a `cost_estimate` body; it is not a reservation or price lock. Omit the header for normal execution. Any other value returns `400 invalid_cost_mode`. Quote mode requires an API key and cannot use MPP or x402.

CostEstimate.description: Read-only cost quote. The intended request is validated but not executed, billed, reserved, or locked.

Cache-Control.description: Quotes are never stored by shared caches.

Vary.description: Response body depends on the cost-mode header.

cost_drivers.effect: charge scales with number of tweets/users returned

x-aisa-pricing.note: nominal_usd is a static reference, NOT a guaranteed minimum; actual charge = provider_cost x multiplier and can be higher or lower

get.description: Get replies to a tweet with control over sort order — Relevance (default), Latest, or Likes — 20 per page, cursor-paginated. Use this instead of `get_twitter_tweet_replies` whenever ordering matters: Likes surfaces the community's top responses, Latest gives a live view of an unfolding thread. Returns full tweet objects with engagement counts.

parameters.name: tweetId
parameters.description: The tweet ID to get replies for. e.g. 1846987139428634858

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor for paginating through results. Leave empty for the first page.

parameters.name: queryType
parameters.description: Sort order for replies. Default is Relevance.

200.description: Tweet replies response. When `X-AISA-Cost-Mode` is `quote`, HTTP 200 returns a `cost_estimate` instead of executing this operation. The quote is not a reservation, authorization, or price lock.

has_next_page.description: Indicates if there are more results available

next_cursor.description: Cursor for fetching the next page of results

msg.description: Error message if status is error.
